mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customers (code, name, phone, email, address, credit_limit, active) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{address}, #{creditLimit}, #{active})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT count(*) FROM customers
AND (name ILIKE #{q} OR code ILIKE #{q} OR phone ILIKE #{q} OR email ILIKE #{q})
mapper.update: UPDATE customers SET name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, address = #{address}, credit_limit = #{creditLimit} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE customers SET active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE customers SET points_balance = #{points} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE customers SET credit_balance = #{balance} WHERE id = #{id}
